question: Will Avalanche exceed $10.18 on CoinGecko at 23:45 UTC on 24 Sep 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the CoinGecko USD price for Avalanche (AVAX) at 2026-09-24T23:45:00.000Z is strictly greater than $10.18.
- "No": Wins if that same price is $10.18 or below.

Clarifications:
- The governing figure is CoinGecko's USD price for id "avalanche-2" at that instant — the last published value at or before 2026-09-24T23:45:00.000Z if there is no tick exactly then.
- CoinGecko is the measure. An exchange-specific pair such as Binance AVAX/USDT can fall on the opposite side of the threshold.
